name: insane-search-templates
description: Local deps for Playwright real-Chrome templates. Stealth via patchright (drop-in Playwright fork, CDP-leak hardened); plain playwright kept as graceful fallback. Install: npm install && npx patchright install chrome. patchright is pinned LOCKSTEP with playwright (exact same version) — bump both together to a version BOTH forks publish (latest common = 1.60.0; playwright has no 1.60.2).
